tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand black: the ground of the gold logo, the ink of the black logo. Text, dark surfaces, and the base under all gold.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand white: ground for the black logo and for light pages. Body text on white uses black.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Highlight at the center of the gold gradient. On black only (18.4:1); fails on white (1.1:1), never use there. As a fill, text on it is always black (18.4:1); gold-dark never sits on it.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Core brand gold, the mid tone of the logo gradient. Text and icons on black (9.2:1). Not for text on white (2.3:1); use gold-dark there. As a fill, text on it is always black (9.2:1); gold-dark never sits on it.

tokens.name: gold-dark
tokens.usage: Bronze at the outer edges of the logo gradient. The one gold that works as text on white (5.1:1). Kept exact to the logo. On black (4.2:1) it is decorative only: borders, dividers, fills; never text. Text on black uses gold, gold-light or white. Never placed on gold or gold-light fills.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light white, dark black (the brand's gold-on-black mode), high contrast white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, inputs, menus: anything sitting on the page. Dark lifts to #121212 so cards read against the black page.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: table header, row hover, disabled inputs, muted pills, info alerts.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. 21:1 light, 18:1 dark, 21:1 high contrast.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav links. High contrast collapses it to black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, table headers, placeholders. ≥4.5:1 on every surface in light and dark; ≥7:1 in high contrast.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold text for emphasis on the page surface: gold-dark in light (5.1:1), gold in dark (9.2:1), a deeper bronze #5e4219 in high contrast (≥7:1). Headings and accents only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, table and divider lines. Decorative in light and dark; solid black in high contrast so every region has a visible edge.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, secondary buttons: ≥3:1 against surface-raised in every theme; black in high contrast.

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Edges of disabled controls.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: black in light, near-white in dark (so gold stays special), black in high contrast.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action and action-hover (≥8:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: nav-active-bg
tokens.usage: The current nav item's fill.

tokens.name: nav-active-text
tokens.usage: Text on nav-active-bg: gold in light and dark (the brand's gold-on-black moment), white in high contrast.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill. Separate from state-alert because dark mode's alert text is a light red that white text can't sit on.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger (≥4.5:1; ≥7:1 in high contrast).

tokens.name: state-alert
tokens.usage: Functional, not brand. Errors, overdue, disenrolment allowed, destructive buttons. Text on white 6.5:1, on state-alert-bg 5.9:1; white text on it 6.5:1. Dark: #fca5a5 on #3b1111. High contrast: #8b0000 (≥7:1). Destructive buttons use the danger token.

tokens.name: state-alert-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind alert pills and error banners; text on it is state-alert.

tokens.name: state-warn
tokens.usage: Functional. Due soon, needs revision, approaching a limit. Text on white 5.0:1, on state-warn-bg 4.8:1. Dark: #fcd34d on #33260a. High contrast: #6b3000 (≥7:1).

tokens.name: state-warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning pills and banners; text on it is state-warn.

tokens.name: state-ok
tokens.usage: Functional. Current, complete, approved. Text on white 5.0:1, on state-ok-bg 4.8:1. Dark: #86efac on #0d2e1a. High contrast: #0a5226 (≥7:1).

tokens.name: state-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind success pills and banners; text on it is state-ok.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Subtle fills: table header row, row hover, muted pill background, disabled inputs, secondary-button hover. Matches the app's ink/5 tint. Never a text color.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Default borders and dividers: cards, table containers and row dividers, the app bar's bottom edge. Matches ink/10. Decorative only (1.3:1), so never the only thing marking a control's edge.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Borders of disabled controls. Matches ink/20.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Control borders: inputs, selects, secondary buttons (3.9:1 on white, above the 3:1 control minimum). Matches ink/50. NOT for text: the app uses ink/50 for captions, but at 3.9:1 it fails body text; use gray-600.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Muted text: captions, hints, table headers, placeholders, roles (5.7:1 on white, 5.1:1 on gray-50). Matches ink/60.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Raw palette, the same in every theme. Components use the semantic tokens (surface, ink, border…) instead, so they follow the theme. Secondary text and inactive nav links (8.5:1); primary-button hover. Matches ink/70.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and greetings. One per page.

styles.name: person-name
styles.usage: Every reference to a participant (and the signed-in staff member): table rows, cards, headers. A person is never set in the UI face.

styles.name: their-words
styles.sample: “Have my own place and a CDL.”
styles.usage: The participant's own words: goals, quotes, narrative in case notes.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: Metric values on dashboards and summary cards. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sorted by how long it has been waiting.
styles.usage: Descriptions, help text, table cells, list rows.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons (at 600), inputs, selects, tabs, nav links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and table column headers, set uppercase (text-transform: uppercase) in ink-muted. Keep to one to three words.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Updated 2 hours ago by M. Chen
styles.usage: Timestamps, hints, errors, audit trails. Nothing is smaller than 12px.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Anything a person might read aloud digit by digit: case and client IDs, dates in tables, receipt and claim numbers, durations, permission codes.

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Dense data screens live between space-2 and space-6; space-8 and up separate page regions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip and badge padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; table cell horizontal padding; gap between form label and field group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap: between form fields, card padding on dense screens, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (between h2 blocks).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding below the header.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side gutters on desktop; separation of major regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Empty states and login or landing hero spacing only.

radius.note: One core radius, 6px: soft enough to feel approachable, square enough for dense tables. Circles are reserved for things that echo the logo's disc: avatars, status dots, count badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner pieces: checkboxes, tags inside inputs, tooltip corners, table row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The core radius: buttons, inputs, selects, dropdown menus, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Containers: cards, panels, dialogs, popovers. Nested items inside use radius-md.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles and pills: avatars, status dots, count badges, filter pills. Echoes the logo's disc.

shadow.note: Light: soft neutral shadows. Dark: shadows vanish on black, so elevation becomes a thin lighter edge plus a deep shadow. High contrast: elevation is a solid black outline.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards and table containers on white; buttons that sit on a surface.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, date pickers, hovered cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, side sheets and toasts: things that sit above everything and block or interrupt.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a double ring like the logo's. Light: white inner, gold-dark outer (5.1:1). Dark: black inner, gold outer (9.2:1). High contrast: white inner, 3px black outer. Never remove focus without replacing it with this.

meta.notes: Brand colors (nmbm-ink/gold) NOT imported: the repo marks them as approximations; this system's sampled values are the source. State colors imported as-is; grays are the solid equivalents of the app's ink/N tints on white.
